comparisons.reason: Item 0 requires a comment to explicitly challenge an underlying assumption or premise of the OP's reasoning, and excludes comments that only dispute facts or the conclusion. Item 1 is broader on the target: any well-reasoned counterargument to the OP's stated view, which can be a conclusion or fact dispute. Item 1 also adds a quality criterion (clear, coherent reasoning) that item 0 does not have. These are different constructs: a premise-challenge subtype versus a general quality counterargument. The two would give different labels for a strong conclusion-only rebuttal.
